answer: Reputation Prism Splitting. Each identity's score is a prism that splits into per-task sub-scores, and new identities inherit the operator's lowest sub-score across all linked wallets, so spawning sybils collapses the whole cluster's rating to its weakest member. A nebula of fresh wallets therefore carries the operator's existing penalty forward rather than resetting it. Operators must post a shale bond per sub-score claim, forfeited when any linked identity underperforms, making each fake identity cost the full bond plus the cluster-wide rating drop.
